newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi-Gemex sells $160 mln debt, yld +300.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi-Gemex sells $160 mln debt, yld +300.

text.p: The following Euro debt issue from Pepsi-Gemex S.A. de C.V was priced in the 144A market on Thursday, according to lead manager Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.

The issue was increased in size by $10 million and was done at the tight side of price talk, which was between 300 and 312.5 basis points, said Dan Vallimarescu, a director in Merrill Lynch's capital markets group. Orders were dominated by U.S. investors and exceeded $320 million, he said.
Grupo Embotellador de Mexico S.A. de C.V. (GGemex) changed its name to Pepsi-Gemex on March 13. It is the second largest Pepsi bottler outside of the U.S., Merrill said.
